== Notes ==
* This spell is occasionally used for the [[55 Monk]] build.
* Perpetually maintainable using [[Arcane Echo]] and a 20% [[of Enchanting]] weapon mod.
* If this is cast on an ally that turns hostile, such as a minion, then any allies attacking the enemy will be knocked down but not take any damage.
{{bug|Shield of Judgment will not be listed in the damage monitor if its damage is reduced to 0.}}
{{anomaly|The concise description states that foes ''[[attacking]]'' target ally will be knocked down and suffer damage; however, this effect only occurs when the target ally is successfully hit.}}

== Trivia ==
* The [[shield]] on the [[skill icon]] is a [[Tall Shield]].
